name: com.michaelo.oxgkit.utilities
description: The OxGKit is a system tool kit commonly used in game development based on Unity design (all are independent tools).

samples.description: Agent Skill (SKILL.md) that teaches AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, etc.) how to use the Utilities: Requester cached downloads, LRU/ARC caches, UISafeAreaAdapter, EasyAnim, TextureAnimation, UMT, and the editor tools. Copy the skill folder into your agent's skills directory after import (see the sample's README).
